workspace.text:

*   Tue, Nov 17: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
*   Wed, Nov 18: 15:00, 15:30
*   Thu, Nov 19: 10:00

Please check these against Elena's and David's calendars and let me know which time works for all four of them. I can then create the booking.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Great, I found a time that works for Priya and Marcus from your list.

I have booked the 30-minute meeting for Thursday, November 19 at 14:30.

Over to you to send the confirmation email. Thanks for the collaboration!
